profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government-lab research center founded in 2020 and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. The company describes itself as making "Advanced AI accessible and Available to Everyone, Everywhere" through its work on generative AI models. TII established the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

TII's primary product is Falcon, an open-source large language model family available under Apache 2.0 license with Middle East data residency. The Falcon series includes multiple models: Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, which TII states is at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models; Falcon 40B trained on one trillion tokens; Falcon-H1 built with hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture; Falcon 2 11B, described as outperforming Meta's LLaMA 3 8B; Falcon Mamba 7B, the first open-source State Space Language Model in the family; and Falcon H1R 7B optimized for reasoning tasks. TII also offers Falcon Perception, a multimodal AI model combining vision and language capabilities, and Falcon Arabic, designed for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects.

Beyond core model development, TII runs developer initiatives including the Wings of Innovation Challenge hackfest, university researcher collaborations, and calls for proposals to support use cases built on Falcon models. The company positions the Falcon family as sovereign AI with emphasis on efficiency and multilingual, multimodal capabilities.
